best_idea: Keep plots as boxes with an owner string in one spatial index, answer who owns a block with a per-block cache, and check placement with an exact box overlap rather than a sampled volume test.
decision_why: The index shape transfers, but only as a derived view of plot rows in the one ledger, with the three defects fixed; not a second store.
acceptance: A server test places a plot, refuses an overlapping plot, finds a one-node plot by a point query at its corner, and refuses building in another player's plot.
